title: Pipeline State (canonical, permissive)
description: Resume save-file for any deliverable workspace (DCT, sales-letter, video-concept, launch). Permissive on purpose: real files across the repo carry different identity-field spellings and different optional blocks. The validator (validate_pipeline_state.py) enforces this contract directly in Python (no jsonschema dependency); this document is the human-readable spec it follows. Three rules: (1) the file must name WHERE it is, (2) WHAT phase it is at, (3) WHEN it was last touched. Everything else is optional passthrough.

identity.comment: At least ONE field from each of the three families below must be present. Aliases exist because the repo grew organically; the validator accepts any alias and warns when the canonical one is absent. New files SHOULD use the canonical spelling.

where_family.note: client+campaign is the canonical pair. A `workspace` path string (e.g. clients/<slug>/campaigns/<campaign>/...) satisfies WHERE on its own because client+campaign are derivable from it.

phase_family.note: current_phase is canonical. `phase` (thomson-reserve launch state) and `current_stage` (older video states) are accepted aliases.

when_family.note: last_updated is canonical. updated_at / last_modified are accepted; created_date alone is accepted (a never-updated file is still legitimately stamped).

known_phase_values.comment: OPEN enum. These are the phase tokens seen in the wild. A value NOT in this list is allowed if it (a) matches one of the structural patterns below or (b) is x- prefixed (explicit custom). Unrecognized + non-x- values produce a WARNING, never a hard fail.

optional_blocks_passthrough.comment: Any of these may be present; none are required; the validator never rejects extra keys. Listed only so a reader knows the common shapes.

hard_fail_conditions: file does not parse as JSON
top-level value is not a JSON object
no field from the WHERE family is present
no field from the PHASE family is present
no field from the WHEN family is present
a present phase value is null or empty string
warn_conditions: canonical identity field absent but an accepted alias is present
phase value is unrecognized AND not x-prefixed AND not matching a structural pattern
phases block present but not an object
last_updated present but not an ISO-ish date string (YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO)
never: reject a file solely for carrying extra/unknown top-level keys
